This review resulted in software hardening releases that address multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities.

These vulnerabilities were found during internal testing and are not known to be actively exploited. To assist customers in patching and streamline the disclosure process, Cisco has grouped these issues by their underlying vulnerability class ��� Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) ��� and assigned a single Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifier (CVE ID).

Cisco has released software updates that address these vulnerabilities. There are no workarounds that address these vulnerabilities.

", "title": "Summary"}, {"category": "general", "text": "These vulnerabilities affect Cisco Nexus Dashboard, regardless of device configuration.
